mesh.description: layer-aligned voxel mesh of 8-node hexahedra: undistorted boxes whose boundary is a staircase approximation of the STL surface

quality.jacobian: constant and positive in every element (det J = hx hy hz / 8); no inverted or distorted elements

inside_test.method: parity of ray crossings along x, y and z through one sample point per cell, majority of three
inside_test.abstained_rays_meaning: rays whose crossing count was odd: they went through a hole or a sheet of zero thickness, so that axis did not vote for that column

warnings: wall thickness has not been measured: run geometry_diagnostics (thickness: run) to find walls thinner than two elements
value.resolution_dependence: Volume, surface area and stresses at inclined or curved faces change with the element size. Repeat the analysis with half the element size to check that the quantities of interest have converged.

parameters.name: wall_thickness
parameters.source: assumed: the tutorial says a support's shell thickness directly sets its stiffness (p. 56) and gives no value

parameters.name: spacing
parameters.source: assumed: CADS Additive's support parameters are documented in its infosheets, not in the Simufact Additive tutorial (p. 54), and the owner's files do not hold them

parameters.name: tooth_height
parameters.source: assumed: no tooth interface unless one is given

parameters.name: relative_density
parameters.source: assumed: supports printed like the part are 100 % dense (tutorial p. 60)

parameters.name: offset_from_part
parameters.source: assumed: no offset from the part's walls

homogenised.applied: each support element takes the full orthotropic stiffness matrix of its band, from the periodic unit cell, times the relative density; supports stay elastic (no yield). The conduction fractions are for the heat model

bands.depth: the whole column below the tooth band

supports.source: the parameters below, each with its own source
supports.critical_angle_source: assumed: the Simufact Additive tutorial names the critical surface angle (p. 55) but gives no value; 45 degrees is the common convention
supports.model: a downward voxel face gets support where a face of the STL flatter than the critical angle lies over it and the column below reaches the plate through empty space; a column that would stand on the part, as inside a closed channel, gets none. The support is of the given type, homogenised from its explicitly solved unit cell (homogenised.bands), activated with its layer and strained like the part

warnings.message: there are no loads, gravity or nonzero prescribed displacements: every displacement and stress will be zero
the voxel mesh approximates inclined and curved surfaces by steps (boundary faces lie up to 8.67e-16 mm from the STL surface); stresses at those surfaces and at re-entrant steps depend on the mesh

value.next_step: lpbf_build_run with the same supports object builds with exactly these supports
